tables.caption_tex: PCOS-attributed infertility rates and contrasts under contemporary GBD population shares.
tables.note_tex: Rates and differences are per 100,000 females, standardized within ages 15--49. Difference is China minus reference; ratio is China divided by reference. Calculations precede rounding, so displayed values may not add or subtract exactly. All values are model point estimates without propagated posterior intervals.

tables.caption_tex: Symmetric PCOS contrast-change decomposition, 1990--2023, by population source.
tables.note_tex: All contributions are per 100,000 females, with fixed standard age weights. Components sum before rounding. UN changes country shares only. Positive and negative components may cancel; percentages use the signed net denominator defined in Methods.

tables.caption_tex: Benchmark definition changes the 2023 PCOS secondary infertility contrast.
tables.note_tex: China's standardized rate is 507.72 per 100,000 throughout. Country weights are applied within each age; the same GBD disease rates and age standard are used. Equal-country rows are identical by construction. Each row represents a different benchmark definition.

figures.caption_tex: \textbf{PCOS-attributed total infertility rates and China-minus-reference differences.} The reference pools the 18 countries within age before fixed-age standardization. Both national and reference modeled rates increase. All values are point estimates without propagated GBD uncertainty.
figures.alt_tex: \textbf{Alt text:} Two-panel line plot. China and the population-pooled reference both increase from 1990 to 2023; the China-minus-reference difference remains negative and narrows from minus 272.92 to minus 121.38 per 100,000.

figures.caption_tex: \textbf{PCOS-attributed primary and secondary infertility trajectories.} The same population-pooled GBD reference and age standard are used. The categories do not track individual transitions.
figures.alt_tex: \textbf{Alt text:} Primary and secondary PCOS-attributed infertility trajectories. The primary contrast remains negative; the secondary contrast approaches zero and is plus 2.16 per 100,000 in 2023 under contemporary GBD reference shares.

figures.caption_tex: \textbf{Absolute symmetric components of changing PCOS contrasts, 1990--2023.} China-rate, reference-rate and reference-share components add to the diamond-marked net changes before rounding. Components with opposing signs cancel; their percentages of the net are descriptive accounting ratios.
figures.alt_tex: \textbf{Alt text:} Bars separate Chinese rate, reference rate and reference share components by infertility type, with diamonds for net changes. For total infertility the components are plus 271.51, minus 208.62 and plus 88.65 per 100,000.

figures.caption_tex: \textbf{Alternative demographic-source weighting of the PCOS comparison.} Panel A shows annual total-infertility differences; panel B shows endpoint decomposition components. Only within-age reference-country shares change between GBD and UN scenarios; disease rates and age weights remain fixed.
figures.alt_tex: \textbf{Alt text:} Annual differences and endpoint components under GBD and UN shares are close. For total infertility, the share component is plus 88.65 with GBD and plus 86.76 with UN; disease rates are held fixed.

figures.caption_tex: \textbf{Benchmark dependence of the 2023 PCOS secondary-infertility difference.} Current-year, fixed-1990 and equal-country reference weights answer different comparison questions. Bars show point estimates under GBD or UN population shares. Equal-country values coincide by construction; no bar represents a confidence interval.
figures.alt_tex: \textbf{Alt text:} Benchmark bars for secondary infertility in 2023. The GBD difference is plus 2.16 with current shares, minus 47.99 with 1990 shares and minus 127.89 with equal-country weights; UN scenarios show the same sign pattern.
